US-Saudi nuclear deal faces uncertainty over Israel recognition clause

The United States has linked a proposed nuclear technology deal with Saudi Arabia to the Kingdom's recognition of Israel. The White House stated the deal is "off" without this condition, while other reports suggest the deal's status is in limbo. The inclusion of this clause introduces significant uncertainty regarding the pact's future.
